|2 = When you reach full Energy Shield, Sacrifice all Energy Shield to gain +5% to all Maximum Resistances for 4 seconds }} '''Everlasting Sacrifice''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that grants a temporary [[buff]] to maximum [[resistance]]s when the character reaches full [[energy shield]], then sacrifices all energy shield. ==Sources== Everlasting Sacrifice can be obtained from the following sources: * {{il|Mahuxotl's Machination}} and its [[Vestigial]] mod * {{psl|Corruption's Embrace}} ([[Chaos Bloodline]]) * {{il|Soul Tether}} with [[Foulborn]] mod {{c|foulborn|Everlasting Sacrifice}} * {{psl|Forbidden Secrets}} ([[Architect of Chaos]] in [[Legacy of Phrecia]]-enabled leagues) ==Mechanics== Everlasting Sacrifice will activate whenever you recover energy shield past your maximum. ES gained from recharge will also count. You do not need to be at less than full energy shield to proc Everlasting Sacrifice. Everlasting Sacrifice will not function if you have 0 maximum energy shield. Everlasting Sacrifice is unaffected by modifiers to [[buff]] effect or duration. ==Strategy== To maintain full uptime of +5% to all Maximum Resistances, the player's [[energy shield]] must be able to reach full energy shield at least once every 4 seconds. This is best achieved by reducing your maximum ES as low as possible while stacking ES recovery, preferably flat regen and ES gain on hit. Percentage ES recovery that scales with maximum ES, including recharge and ES leech, are less viable due to it being much slower. Some choices of viable energy shield recovery include: * Flat ES regeneration - easy to obtain, but affected by recovery rate reductions and damage over time; can use {{psl|Divine Flesh}} to prevent damage from interfering with regen ** Body armour crafted suffix {{c|crafted|Regenerate 150 Energy Shield per second while a Rare or Unique Enemy is Nearby}} ** {{c|mod|Regenerate (9-20) Energy Shield per second}} prefix on [[abyss jewel]]s ** {{il|Malachai's Vision}} - requires fully [[corrupted]] gear, which coincidentally synergizes with {{psl|Corruption's Embrace}} ** {{il|Rise of the Phoenix}} with Foulborn mod {{c|foulborn|Regenerate 100-200 Energy Shield per second}} ** Sources that grant ES regen based on life regen (Ex. {{psl|Pious Path}}, Foulborn {{il|Voll's Vision}}) * ES gain on hit ** {{il|Cobalt Jewel}} suffix {{c|mod|Gain (2-3) Energy Shield per Enemy Hit with Attacks}} ** The {{il|Watcher's Eye}} mod - requires {{il|Discipline}} (which is counterintuitive unless you plan to use {{il|Energy Blade}}) and requires rapid hitting skills or skills with multiple projectiles ** {{il|Fenumus' Spinnerets}} - requires {{sl|id=AspectOfTheSpider}} ** {{il|Malachai's Mark}} * {{il|The Sorrow of the Divine}} or {{il|Replica Sorrow of the Divine}} with life flasks - requires flask charge generation for boss fights; cannot be used with Mahuxotl's Machination ** with {{psl|Master Surgeon}} on [[Pathfinder]] - can maintain charge uptime and outpace ES degen with enough investment into flask passives, but does not recover any Life ** with {{il|Forbidden Taste}} - same as above, causes a persistent Chaos degen * {{psl|Supreme Decadence}} - requires life flask charge generation * {{il|Tawhanuku's Timing}} - can be automated with {{il|Automation}}; requires increasing the skill's cost if using Mahuxotl's Machination e.g. {{il|Archmage Support}}, {{il|Lifetap Support}}, {{il|The Covenant}} * {{il|Demon Stitcher}} - reliable source of ES gain for spell builds if life loss can be compensated; can't be automated * {{psl|Ghost Dance}}/{{psl|Divine Shield}} - requires receiving a hit regularly * ES [[Kill|Gain on Kill]] - will require a way to generate killable enemies (e.g. {{il|The Writhing Jar}}, {{sl|Penance Mark}}) against single targets; flat ES recovery preferred (Ex. {{il|Voidbringer}}, {{il|Doryani's Fist}}) Reducing the energy shield pool is generally preferred, which provides some use to items like {{il|Daresso's Salute}}, {{il|Ming's Heart}}, or [[Reflecting Mist|reflected]] jewelry with negative maximum energy shield mods, or by minimizing increases to ES by redirecting Intelligence bonuses with {{psl|Solipsism}}, {{il|Faithguard}}, or {{il|Crystallised Omniscience}}. The only exception would be for {{il|Energy Blade}} builds, which instead want to maximize ES and use % sources of ES recovery instead (stacking Strength and Intelligence, using {{il|Shaper's Touch}}, etc). Note that you would need to cast Energy Blade prior to equipping the shield, as the skill costs Energy Shield to use. Note that maintaining Everlasting Sacrifice will be significantly harder if the sources of Everlasting Sacrifice also adds additional maximum ES (e.g. {{il|Mahuxotl's Machination}} and [[Foulborn]] {{il|Soul Tether}} without both Foulborn mods). Otherwise, you will need only a miniscule amount of maximum ES above 0 to maintain it. With {{psl|Eldritch Battery}}, you can maintain permanent uptime by scaling recharge rate. You will need at least 50% increased recharge rate plus extra to maintain your skill costs to maintain permanent uptime with recharge rate alone. ==Unique items== Droppable unique item related to Everlasting Sacrifice: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Everlasting Sacrifice%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.14.1c| * Fixed a bug with the {{il|Mahuxotl's Machination}} unique shield where Everlasting Sacrifice could sometimes fail to trigger when reaching full energy shield. }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} [[Category:Keystone passive skills]] [[Category:keywords]] {{Sister|poe2wiki}}
